core_obligations: Apply the base uniqueness lemma on the covering U -> X to get uniqueness of the point of |U| over x.
Transfer: any point of |X| over x lifts to |U| (surjectivity), and uniqueness on U pushes down to X.
proof_roadmap: Uniqueness on the cover; transfer to the space.
difficulty_reason: A thin refinement of the base uniqueness lemma via surjective etale transfer.
